# CI installs the packed tool on Windows and Linux
<!-- GENERATED from the Phrase Board (issue #177, sha256:1a0abadfb9707ce8e1a41bb82beaf870425c1ea34c381d1d9ac7e5de6f5adc29). Do not edit this file: edit the issue. -->


- **Status:** Ready
- **Shape:** Story
- **Type:** tooling (S; v0.1 bar 1)
- **Milestone:** Purpose: verifiability, preserved intent and reviewability
- **Source:** The v0.1 public preview bar (docs/release/v0.1-bar.md) and Decider D121 (2026-10-29).
- **Depends on:** 176
- **Story:** As Dana, I want proof that the tool installs and runs on both systems I might use, so that the install step does not fail on my machine for a reason the mob could have seen.
- **Acceptance criteria (Given/When/Then; at most 3, each failing on partial work):**
  1. Given the packed tool, When CI runs, Then a job on Windows and a job on Linux install it from a local feed and run phrase --version and phrase build on the Tasks demo
  2. Given the jobs, When the version in the package differs from the version printed, Then the job fails
  3. Given CI timing, When the jobs run, Then they add no more than a few minutes and the existing jobs are unchanged

## Context

- A regression in installability turns CI red, in the style of the Usable v1 job. Follow docs/CODING_GUIDELINES.md; keep the change small enough to revert alone.
